entries.reason: PR #368 region-boundary fix (covenant regions bounded at the next cross-article bare heading). Reviewer findings: 8 HELDOUT sources move on COVERAGE_GAP/UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS: COVERAGE_GAP +13, UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS -29. Of the 13 COVERAGE_GAP, 8 are direct overrun (exceptions previously 'bound' only by clauses whose citations overran into later articles) and 5 are overrun plus a false match on the 30-character opening. The 30-character-opening false match is a separate scorer weakness, tracked as a follow-up. The new errors are boilerplate (LLC member/distribution, assignment, amendment and agency text), not covenant gaps. Material per-source increases accepted: exhibit1013q24 10->15, ss171930_ex1001 19->21. Also, 4 sources have DISCOVERY_GAP -7. HELDOUT total 2618->2595, UNSUPPORTED 144->115; thresholds and membership unchanged. Evidence: docs/clf-scoreboard/pr368-region-overrun-evidence.md
